mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment above 5.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days due to heightened economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: The UNRATE does not rise above 5.0% within the next 3 months, or 5-day forward returns remain non-negative despite the rate increase.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both GDP (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) above 5% month-over-month predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next quarter due to expanded economic activity.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 5% AND HOUST growth > 5% in the next month
failure_condition: The combined growth of GDPC1 and HOUST does not exceed 5% month-over-month, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained low federal funds rates (below 4.0%) and robust GDP growth (GDPC1) drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The regime is not a late-cycle expansion (e.g., GDP growth < 3% or FEDFUNDS ≥ 4.0%), or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 102.0 signals supply-side expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next quarter.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not increase by more than 2.0 points over the next quarter, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the RSAFS demand index exceeds 400.0 million dollars, it triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days as strong demand boosts market confidence.
failure_condition: RSAFS does not exceed 400.0 million within the next month, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) combined with robust labor growth (PAYEMS > 1,000,000) predicts positive S&P 500 returns within 5 days due to strong labor market conditions.
failure_condition: Either UNRATE ≥ 4.0% or PAYEMS ≤ 1,000,000, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a post-recession recovery regime, falling unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and rising labor participation (PAYEMS > 1,200,000) drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next quarter.
failure_condition: The regime is not post-recession (e.g., UNRATE ≥ 4.5% or PAYEMS < 1,200,000), or 60-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).
